name: health-briefing-deck
description: Three-slide HyperFrames deck and linear video for the Health Briefing prototype (non-technical healthcare strategy audience).

scripts.lint: npm run video:sync && HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 HYPERFRAMES_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 hyperframes lint && HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 HYPERFRAMES_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 hyperframes lint video
scripts.check: npm run video:sync && HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 HYPERFRAMES_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 hyperframes check --strict --at-transitions --at 3.45,8.85,13.95,18.4,22.45,27.95,32.9,38.4,43.45,49.55,52.5,59.9 && HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 HYPERFRAMES_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 hyperframes check --strict --at-transitions --at 3.45,8.85,13.95,18.4,22.45,27.95,32.9,38.4,43.45,49.55,52.5,59.9 video
scripts.snapshot: HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 HYPERFRAMES_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 hyperframes snapshot --at 5.6,10.9,18.4,24.9,31.6,38.4,48.9,52.5,59.9 --no-end --describe false -o dist/snapshots
scripts.render: npm run video:sync && HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 HYPERFRAMES_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 hyperframes render video -o dist/health-briefing-stakeholders.mp4 --quality standard --fps 30
